description: Extract a page's machine-readable self-description in one call: every JSON-LD block (schema.org), OpenGraph and Twitter Card metadata, canonical URL, title, meta description, H1, hreflang alternates and RSS/Atom feed links — parsed server-side into clean JSON. Where text extraction gives you prose, this gives you structured facts. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page

name: agentbit.structured_extract
title: Structured Data Extract
